description: SmartPay provides a unified payments platform for Indian SMBs — payments, invoicing, and simple receipts.

faqs.a: SmartPay enables merchants to accept payments, generate invoices and reconcile transactions in one dashboard.

faqs.q: Do you have a free tier?
faqs.a: We offer a limited free tier for up to 100 transactions per month. Paid plans add advanced reporting and integrations.
Small and medium businesses, retail stores, and online sellers in India who need a simple payments + receipts solution.
Pricing is tier-based: Free tier, Standard (monthly fee + per-transaction), and Enterprise custom pricing.
